_how_to_use: Each clip in queue/ must name a campaign key from this file (in its .json sidecar, field 'campaign'). Clips with no valid, active campaign are NOT posted. Add one entry per Whop/Vyro campaign you join. 'organic' is only for content you own or have explicit permission to post.

organic.name: Organic (no paid campaign)
organic.notes: Only for content you own or have explicit permission to post. No #ad.
